module: Node "Recover In Place" (category `once_instant`). Recovers a vehicle in place: `veh:resetBrokenFlexMesh()` then `spawn.safeTeleport` at the current position with the current direction/up, so it is not inside an obstacle (it may be moved slightly). Input pin: `vehId` (default: player).
notes: The description of the `vehId` pin says "to freeze" (copy-paste).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

workOnce.desc: Resets the broken flexmeshes to zero then safely teleports the vehicle in place.
